input.content: Use the x_search tool with x_keyword_search only, mode=Latest. Run exactly this query: "Elon Musk xAI announcement since:2026-08-21 until:2026-09-03". Return up to 10 X posts, one per line as "URL - one-line summary (@handle, YYYY-MM-DD)". Posts only, no commentary.

content.text:
**Elon Musk's xAI announcements** primarily center on the company's founding in 2023 as a "maximum truth-seeking AI" alternative to competitors like OpenAI, with early milestones including the Grok chatbot (initially released in late 2023 for X Premium+ users) and its open-sourcing.[[1]](https://www.reuters.com/technology/musks-xai-launch-improved-version-chatbot-2024-03-29/)

Subsequent developments include:
- **Grok-1.5 launch (March 2024)**: An improved version with better performance in coding and math tasks, rolled out to early testers and X users.[[1]](https://www.reuters.com/technology/musks-xai-launch-improved-version-chatbot-2024-03-29/)
- **Acquisition of X (formerly Twitter, March 2025)**: xAI acquired the social platform for $33 billion (part of a combined ~$113 billion valuation including debt), integrating it with Grok and data-sharing features.[[2]](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-03-28/musk-says-that-his-xai-startup-has-acquired-x-for-33-billion?srnd=homepage-americas)
- **Major data center announcement (November 2025)**: A 500-megawatt facility in Saudi Arabia, powered by Nvidia chips, in partnership with HUMAIN AI—larger than xAI's Colossus 1 in Memphis (300 MW). Musk discussed broader visions for humanoid robots, space-based AI compute via solar-powered satellites, and future data centers.[[3]](https://www.aol.com/articles/elon-musk-announces-massive-xai-172332381.html?guccounter=1)
- **SpaceX merger (February 2026)**: SpaceX acquired xAI, forming a vertically integrated entity valued at $1.25 trillion. This combined Grok, Starlink, X, and rocket tech, with ambitions for space-based AI data centers (estimated lowest-cost AI compute in 2–3 years), lunar factories, mass drivers for satellites, Moon bases, and Mars civilization. The deal preceded a major SpaceX IPO.[[4]](https://www.theverge.com/tech/872619/elon-musk-merges-spacex-with-xai-and-x)[[5]](https://apnews.com/article/spacex-xai-musk-space-2079f03fa888652b7fe836afe8b670a1)

Post-merger updates (February 2026 onward) involved significant reorganization:
- Multiple co-founders departed (leaving about half of the original 12), with Musk citing the need for structural evolution to improve execution speed.
- New teams formed around Grok (including voice), coding (Grok Code, aiming for state-of-the-art in months), Imagine (video/image generation, e.g., outperforming Google's Nano Banana), and Macrohard (AI for simulating computer use and entire corporations).
- Public all-hands meeting shared on X emphasized interplanetary ambitions, such as orbital data centers (100–200 GW/year scaling to terawatts), Moon-based AI satellite factories, and capturing solar energy at massive scales for advanced intelligence.[[6]](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/11/xai-lays-out-interplanetary-ambitions-in-public-all-hands/)[[7]](https://www.reuters.com/business/musk-says-xai-was-reorganized-2026-02-11/)[[8]](https://www.ft.com/content/758b3d7d-e94f-40ba-b705-23341ca9bdfe)

By July 2026, the combined entity was officially renamed **SpaceXAI** (with a new logo and X account @SpaceXAI), focusing on Starmind infrastructure for space data centers (demos in 2027, commercial in 2028). This reflects Musk's long-term push for truth-seeking AI integrated with space tech.[[9]](https://mashable.com/tech/xai-spacexai-name)

Earlier internal updates (e.g., 2025 all-hands) highlighted xAI's focus on "maximally truth-seeking" systems to avoid dystopian risks from dishonest AI, with plans like Macrohard as a Microsoft competitor.[[10]](https://nytimes.com/2025/09/18/technology/elon-musk-artificial-intelligence-xai.html)

These announcements trace xAI's evolution from a startup rivaling OpenAI/Google to a merged, space-oriented powerhouse under Musk. For the absolute latest, check official sources like xAI's or Musk's X account, as developments continue rapidly.
